findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_community_activity, get_community_activity_in_area · Private data: search_detections, get_detection_details, get_field_reference · Public sink: get_department_profile · Destructive: get_community_activity, get_community_activity_in_area.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_community_activity, get_community_activity_in_area · Private data: search_detections, get_detection_details, get_field_reference · Public sink: get_department_profile · Destructive: get_community_activity, get_community_activity_in_area

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
